ios.desc:
Start your day with total clarity.
Stay on top of your routines, chores, and tasks — all in one minimalist app.
Build streaks, track progress, and stay consistent without overthinking.

YourChecklist is your all-in-one daily checklist and routine tracker.
Designed to make repetitive tasks feel rewarding and stress-free, this app helps you create, manage, and complete your personalized routines — whether it’s a morning ritual, work prep, or weekend chores.

What You’ll Love:
- Daily, Weekly & Monthly Checklists
  Create recurring routines with flexible frequency options.

- Smart Reminders
  Get notified right on time — never miss a beat.

- Streak Tracking & Progress History
  Celebrate consistency and stay motivated with visual progress.

- Checklist Templates
  Start quickly with pre-built routines for mornings, work, travel, and more.

Perfect For:
 Morning & evening rituals 
 Workday prep & shutdown routines
 Habit tracking
 Fitness & wellness plans
 Cleaning schedules & weekly resets
 Travel packing lists
 ADHD & productivity support

No sign-up. No clutter. Your data stays on your device.
YourChecklist is built for speed, simplicity, and peace of mind.

Privacy Policy: https://your-checklist-privacy-policy.vercel.app/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: YourChecklist – A lightweight daily checklist app that resets every day

quotes.text:
I recently launched YourChecklist, a super minimal daily checklist app built with SwiftUI. While the to-do list space is saturated, I noticed most apps don’t support one key behavior: auto-resetting tasks each day — something critical for habit-building.

I also took a data-driven approach using App Store Optimization (ASO) — researching low-competition, high-search keywords and targeting specific regions to gain early traction.

Would love to hear feedback from the HN community — UX, technical, or growth-wise.
